sceneCalibration.exclusionCoordinateSystem: Conservative image-coordinate strip, applied on every frame; saved dog boxes are additionally padded and excluded in each frame.
sceneCalibration.basis: Visual inspection of original frames 0, 30 and 59 at source resolution and an all-60-frame contact sheet, without human gait labels: textured dark floor below the rear screen, separate upper screen texture, and handler confined to the left strip. Geometry selects scene texture independently of predicted paws. The floor appears to be a fixed mat; this is an explicit scene assumption checked against independent background motion, not proof that all surfaces are stationary.
sceneCalibration.clearanceReason: The wall/floor seam lies behind the dog's walking plane. The visible floor is an area in perspective, not a calibrated paw-height line. No supported same-depth support line or height uncertainty bound is available; floor overlap cannot provide clearance.
sceneCalibration.annotationPolicy: No Dog02 human paw coordinates, gait labels, event times, continuity declarations or annotation scores are inputs. No calibration or rule is tuned to event output.

limitations: All states, events and sequences are unverified evidence-based candidates.
Projected ground evidence does not establish force or weight bearing.
Pose scores and rule thresholds are not calibrated event probabilities.
Upstream ground registration, scale, clearance and identity require validation.
Position peaks are separate kinematic candidates; no clinical accuracy is claimed.
All outputs are candidates, not biologically verified contact or gait.
Ground/background agreement is a consistency check, not proof that a surface is stationary.
A similarity model rejects unsupported perspective/parallax instead of correcting it.
Floor-region overlap is not clearance; no height is inferred without independent geometry.
Saved association outputs are uncertain motion-only hypotheses, not verified physical identity.
No human annotations or model training/inference are used.

conversion.method: OpenCV VideoCapture to VideoWriter, mp4v, source nominal 12 fps; all frames retained, no audio copied

provenance.alignment: All 60 original native PTS/frame indices/dimensions match the documented derivative and saved predictions within 1 microsecond. Lossy derivative pixels are not asserted identical to the original.
provenance.originalPixelVerification: Full existing source manifest comparison passed for all original frames, including PNG and decoded-pixel hashes.
provenance.savedIdentityPolicy: Read-only saved arbitrary IDs 0/1; unresolved slots abstain. No human A/B mapping and no tracker rerun.
